translations.web: The upright will see it, and be glad. All the wicked will shut their mouths.
translations.bsb: The upright see and rejoice, and all iniquity shuts its mouth.
translations.kjv: The righteous shall see it, and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.
translations.asv: The upright shall see it, and be glad; And all iniquity shall stop her mouth.
